allow: PowerShell($total = \(Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\).Sum; Write-Host "Total size: $\([math]::Round\($total / 1GB, 2\)\) GB, File count: $\(\(Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Count\)")

PowerShell($gitSize = \(Get-ChildItem -Path ".git" -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\).Sum / 1MB; Write-Host ".git folder: $\([math]::Round\($gitSize, 2\)\) MB")

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path "plate_logo_service"\) { Get-ChildItem "plate_logo_service" -Recurse | Select-Object -First 5 FullName }; $exists = Test-Path "plate_logo_service"; Write-Host "Exists: $exists")

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path "qczj"\) { $size = \(Get-ChildItem "qczj" -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\).Sum / 1MB; Write-Host "qczj size: $\([math]::Round\($size, 2\)\) MB" } else { Write-Host "qczj deleted" })
